content.short: WOOFi is a cross-chain DEX by WOO Network that bridges institutional liquidity from centralized markets directly to on-chain DeFi pools.
content.description: WOOFi is a decentralized exchange developed by WOO Network that uniquely integrates institutional market making liquidity from Wootrade  WOO's professional trading arm  into on-chain liquidity pools. This direct access to institutional-grade liquidity results in tight spreads and low price impact that most DEXes cannot match. WOOFi is deployed across multiple chains including Mantle, offering competitive rates for token swaps and a synthetic pro trading interface for advanced users.
content.meta: WOOFi is a cross-chain DEX bridging WOO Network's institutional liquidity to on-chain DeFi on Mantle. Discover WOOFi on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
